title: TasteX observation v1

material_lots.description: Null or absent lot is allowed only for an ingredient with actual mass zero; runtime validates this conditional relation.

actualText.pattern: ^(?!\s)(?![\s\S]*\u0000)(?![\s\S]*待填)(?!(?:[Uu][Nn][Kk][Nn][Oo][Ww][Nn]|[Nn][Uu][Ll][Ll]|[Nn][Oo][Nn][Ee]|[Nn]/[Aa]|[Nn][Aa]|[Tt][Bb][Dd]|[Tt][Oo][Dd][Oo]|未填写|未提供|未知|请输入)$)[\s\S]*\S$

description: A completed observation, not the intentionally incomplete observation template. Zero is distinct from a missing null rating. Runtime additionally validates hashed run artifacts, dynamic dimensions/ingredients, material lots, finite numbers and corrections. Hashes are consistency checks, not authenticity signatures.
x-runtime-validation: Every declared run artifact hash must match; brief, design and template are mandatory.
run_id,case_id,revision,scope must match the persisted run; batch/cell must exist.
actual_masses_g keys match planned_sample_masses_g exactly; actual base mass >0.
Each actual nonzero ingredient requires a non-placeholder material lot; no unknown ingredient keys.
ratings keys exactly match all design dimensions; explicit null means missing, not zero.
Normal stores accept only human_observed; synthetic_test needs isolated temporary test mode.
supersedes must reference the current observation of the same run/sample/participant/scope/origin.
One current observation per run/batch/cell/participant/origin; repeated sampling requires a new planned batch/run.
JSON numbers must be finite; actualText rejects surrounding whitespace, null bytes and placeholder values.
